question: How many vacation days do I get?

sources.content: Full-time employees receive twenty days of paid vacation per year. Unused days carry over to March.
Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval.

answers.label: Grounded answer
answers.text: Full-time employees receive twenty days of paid vacation per year. Unused days carry over to March.

answers.label: Wrong number
answers.text: Full-time employees receive thirty days of paid vacation per year.
